author: Animalogic
description:
Dinos ruled the earth for millions of years, but after the asteroid, reptiles and birds took a back seat to the mammals. We took over. This is the story of how our ancestor emerged from the ashes and spread all over the world, eventually setting the stage for human beings to appear.

Examining the nature of the beast.

From apex predators to the planet's strangest creatures, Animalogic goes deep into the science, behavior, and biology of the animal kingdom, one species at a time.
